summary: DEV-3: TASK_024_FULL_RESULTS.md has wrong total (154 = Task 015 field-atoms, rows sum 144), wrong accept-reason labels ('5 PARTIAL+MATCHER_ACCEPT'), and mixed-unit Task-015 comparison table
root_cause: Full-Results report assembled without: (a) checking total-row denominators against verdict-row sum, (b) generating accept-reason breakdowns from results JSON instead of prose, (c) asserting metric units before building the Task-015 comparison table
what_i_did_wrong: Task 024 report was published with hand-derived totals, hand-written accept reasons that contradicted the results JSON, and a comparison table that put micro-F1 next to cell-accept rates without unit labels — none caught before Task 025's reconciliation
response: Documented all three defects in TASK_025_ANALYSIS.md §1/§4/§11; left TASK_024_FULL_RESULTS.md unmodified per analysis-only rules; filed NCR-2026-09-22-TASK025-003; deferred errata handling to reviewer as decision item 3
